mechanism.return_payload: ctrs.hrd[s][ll] ORs four banks for lane ll. Physical bank index is vertical; ll is horizontal CTNL column. HRQ source pin x already follows ll via tools/s81/hc_return_pins.py. The output slots are fixed to legacy CTRN pin positions. RTL-wide tq/farq selection fans across all columns; no direct HRQ/fault pin capture exists before merge.
mechanism.flags: nflt/pflt/hnz enter direct combinational reduction into rvm. Simply duplicating tq/farq does not repair the fault capture path.
mechanism.current_prohibition: Do not report a gate WARN or placement-only ETM as native qualification. Do not add transparent per-input flops without matching data/control timing: that changes merge epoch.

proposed_sequence.implementation: Keep separate actual registered copies tq_col[0..3], lq_col[0..3], farq_col[0..3] at the same existing input-capture cycle (keep attributes, actual pin binding). Select each return output bit from its lane-column copy; no added cycle.
proposed_sequence.exactness: Bitwise equality with original tq/lq/farq on every cycle; PIPE1 production exact + observed selected-bit/control mutant required.

proposed_sequence.implementation: Use four narrow hard return engines per CTRA/B. Route each ll bank-OR and corresponding payload insertion locally; export exact logical rdm bit names grouped physically by lane ll. Build an actual successor CTRN with matched grouped rdm input positions; group both sides consistently through the next native transport endpoint.
proposed_sequence.per_bit_identity: HRQ global index 64*S_RT*(4*bank+ll)+64*s+b reduces into hrd[256*s+64*ll+b]. Output payload k may select hrd[k%GT] with GT4. Retain the exact current g0/tq comparison and OR order (bitwise OR is associative) and BF16 insert fields. No arithmetic/rounding change.
proposed_sequence.integration: This is a physical endpoint regrouping, not a new logical bus permutation. All parent wires remain indexed by the original semantic names; exact rebind CSV plus observed mislabeled-bit mutant is mandatory. Do not merely move the crossings to a parent bus.

proposed_sequence.implementation: If fault flags still exceed native capture after narrow-engine distribution, introduce actual per-column flag capture and an explicit merge leaf. That necessarily adds a flag epoch unless an existing stage can be retimed. Prove an exact retiming of rv/read/output control or explicitly price and reschedule the additional fixed cycle. Do not claim same-epoch capture with a newly inserted input register.
proposed_sequence.blocking_decision: Actual parent source/schedule integration required; no implementation or cost waiver claimed.

proposed_sequence.implementation: Regenerate all affected real pin plans/LEFs, update actual parent source/clock roots/reset and price any additional cycles/area/cuts before route. TT setup, FF hold and DRC0 plus native launch<=220/capture<=190 and actual per-pin clock references remain mandatory.

required_before_adoption: actual canonical2417 HC parent identity and child homes
real per-column ingress and downstream CTRN peer-bound pin map
kept same-cycle control replication RTL, exact PIPE1+observable negative controls
model-priced structural split and any explicit retiming
